caption: The drawing depicts a long dress shown from the back, rendered in grayscale. The dress has a high, fitted collar and long sleeves that are decorated with horizontal rows of intricate, repeated geometric and curved patterns. The upper portion of the dress, including the back and sleeves, features a sheer or semi-transparent fabric with similar patterned embroidery. A wide sash or belt is tied at the waist, with the ends draping down. The bodice has a fitted structure, while the skirt falls to the floor in soft, slightly gathered folds. The skirt is ornamented with wide vertical and horizontal bands that carry ornamental designs matching those on the sleeves and bodice. The drawing does not include a head, feet, or hands, and is set against a plain background. The shading suggests a satin-like sheen on the skirt and more matte, textured patterns on the upper part.
title: Street Dress
